newsitem.title: USA: GE gets $235 mln U.S. defense turbine kit contract.
newsitem.headline: GE gets $235 mln U.S. defense turbine kit contract.

text.p: General Electric Co is getting a $235 million firm fixed price contract from the U.S. Defense Department for an estimated 790 turbine kits for military aircraft.
The Pentagon said in a news release that GE of Cincinnati, will provide TF-39-1C High Pressure Turbine Kits for the TF-39 engine on C-5 aircraft.
The contract is expected to be completed October 2002, the Pentagon said. It said contract funds will not expire at the end of the current fiscal year.
